text: Even dishonesty was sometimes hard for me to define in these relationships. Bee once opened a door and, a second later, said she hadn’t opened it. That drove me crazy, because why would she lie like that? On the other hand, although she was technically lying, there was no strategy behind it, and she was usually quite honest. Non-strategic lying is literally defined as "pathological lying," so I should have seen it more like an illness than a failure of virtue.
